spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (भवति)
1 To be, to become, to exist.
2 To be born or produced.
r. 10th cl. (भावयति)
1 To mix.
2 To think.
3 To be clear or pure.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (भवति-त भावयति-ते)
To obtain. The first form of this root takes most of the prefixes, and then possesses a great variety of applications.
With अधि,
To rule or preside over.
With अनु,
1 To feel, to apprehend or perceive.
2 To do, to make.
3 To enjoy.
4 To investigate.
With अभि,
1 To overcome.
2 To pain or afflict.
With उत्,
To be born or produced.
With परा,
To be vanquished.
With प्र,
1 To become manifest, to appear, to come into sight or existence.
2 To be equal to in personal conflict, to be a match for.
3 To rule, to be supreme, to preside over.
4 To be beyond or over.
5 To proceed.
With प्रति,
To be substituted for.
With परि,
1 To disrespect.
2 To surround.
With वि,
1 To see.
2 To uphold.
3 To prove.
4 To have majesty, or power.
With वि and अति,
व्यतिभवते,
To be mutually or reciprocally.
With सं,
1 To be possible.
2 To exist, to be born or produced.
3 To contain.
4 To overcome.
5 To be able or adequate.
6 To associate, to collect, to mix or assemble.
7 To nourish.

f. (भूः)
1 The earth.
2 Place, site, the place of being or abiding.
3 Sacrificial fire.
ind. (भू)
The lowest of the seven hells.
E.
भू to be, aff. क्विप्.
